description.zh:
女巫是好人阵营的强力神职，拥有一瓶解药和一瓶毒药。解药可以救活当晚被狼人杀死的玩家，毒药可以毒死任意一名玩家。每瓶药只能使用一次，同一晚不能同时使用两瓶药。女巫每晚会得知被刀玩家的身份，需要决定是否使用药物。

常用策略包括：第一晚根据被刀者重要性决定是否救人；确认狼人身份后再使用毒药避免误毒；隐藏身份避免成为狼人目标；可以跳出报银水（被救的玩家）建立信任；盲毒明显的悍跳狼；留毒等待更确定的目标。注意不要误毒猎人，否则猎人无法开枪。
description.en:
The Witch is a powerful special role with one heal and one poison potion. The heal saves the player killed by werewolves that night, while poison kills any player. Each potion is single-use, and both cannot be used the same night. The Witch learns who was killed each night and must decide whether to use potions.

Common strategies include: deciding whether to save based on killed player's importance on night one; using poison only after confirming werewolf identity to avoid mistakes; hiding identity to avoid becoming a target; revealing to report silver water (saved player) to build trust; blind poisoning obvious fake Seers; saving poison for more certain targets. Avoid poisoning the Hunter, as they cannot shoot if poisoned.

night.zh: 得知当晚被狼人杀死的玩家，可以选择：1) 使用解药救人 2) 使用毒药毒人 3) 不使用药
night.en: Learn who was killed by werewolves, can choose: 1) Use heal to save 2) Use poison to kill 3) Use no potion

day.zh: 参与发言和投票，可以选择跳出身份或隐藏
day.en: Participate in speeches and voting, can reveal identity or hide

passive.zh: 解药和毒药各一瓶，每瓶只能使用一次
passive.en: One heal and one poison potion, each usable once

win_condition.en: All werewolves are eliminated through voting

basic.zh: 第一晚解药策略：如果被刀的是神职或关键玩家，考虑使用解药
basic.en: Night one heal strategy: Consider using heal if killed player is special role or key player

basic.zh: 毒药使用时机：确认狼人身份后再使用毒药，避免浪费
basic.en: Poison timing: Use poison after confirming werewolf identity, avoid waste

basic.zh: 隐藏身份：不要过早暴露女巫身份，避免成为狼人目标
basic.en: Hide identity: Don't reveal Witch identity too early, avoid becoming werewolf target

basic.zh: 配合预言家：根据预言家的查验信息决定毒药目标
basic.en: Coordinate with Seer: Decide poison target based on Seer's verification info

advanced.zh: 盲毒策略：第一晚如果有明显的狼人嫌疑（如悍跳预言家），可以盲毒
advanced.en: Blind poison: Night one if there's obvious werewolf suspect (like fake Seer), can blind poison

advanced.zh: 留毒策略：不急于使用毒药，等待确认狼人身份后再毒
advanced.en: Save poison: Don't rush to use poison, wait for confirmed werewolf identity

advanced.zh: 自救策略：如果自己被刀，可以使用解药自救（规则允许的情况下）
advanced.en: Self-save: If killed, can use heal to save yourself (if rules allow)

advanced.zh: 解药心理战：第一晚不救人，让狼人以为女巫不在场或已用解药
advanced.en: Heal psychology: Don't save night one, make werewolves think Witch is absent or used heal

advanced.zh: 报银水：如果救了某人，白天可以跳出报告救人信息（银水）
advanced.en: Report silver water: If saved someone, can reveal and report save info (silver water)

expert.zh: 首夜盲毒悍跳狼：如果确信某人是悍跳狼，第一晚直接毒死
expert.en: Night one blind poison fake Seer: If certain someone is fake Seer, poison immediately

expert.zh: 空城计：解药已用后，假装还有解药威慑狼人
expert.en: Empty city strategy: After using heal, pretend to still have it to deter werewolves

expert.zh: 双开策略：在关键局面跳出身份，报告解药和毒药使用情况
expert.en: Double reveal: In key moments, reveal identity and report heal/poison usage

expert.zh: 毒边缘人：如果局势不明朗，毒发言模糊、可能是狼的边缘玩家
expert.en: Poison marginal players: If situation unclear, poison vague speakers who may be wolves

expert.zh: 配合守卫：如果知道守卫位置，可以协调保护策略
expert.en: Coordinate with Guard: If Guard position known, can coordinate protection strategy

expert.zh: 遗言毒人：如果白天被投出局，遗言中暗示毒药目标给好人阵营
expert.en: Last words poison: If voted out during day, hint poison target in last words for village

when_to_use.zh: 被刀的是确认的神职（预言家、猎人等）
when_to_use.en: Killed player is confirmed special role (Seer, Hunter, etc.)

when_to_use.zh: 被刀的是强势好人或警长
when_to_use.en: Killed player is strong villager or Sheriff

when_to_use.zh: 第一晚被刀的可能是预言家（狼人盲刀神职）
when_to_use.en: Night one kill may be Seer (werewolves blind killing special roles)

when_not_to_use.zh: 被刀的是边缘玩家或可疑玩家
when_not_to_use.en: Killed player is marginal or suspicious

when_not_to_use.zh: 想留解药保护自己或后续关键玩家
when_not_to_use.en: Want to save heal for yourself or future key players

when_not_to_use.zh: 第一晚盲救，不确定被刀者身份
when_not_to_use.en: Night one blind save, uncertain of killed player's identity

when_to_use.zh: 预言家查验出狼人身份
确认的悍跳狼（假预言家）
发言明显暴露狼人身份的玩家
when_to_use.en: Player whose speech clearly reveals werewolf identity

when_to_use.zh: 关键轮次需要快速减少狼人数量
when_to_use.en: Critical round needing to quickly reduce werewolf count

when_not_to_use.zh: 不确定目标身份，可能误毒好人
when_not_to_use.en: Uncertain of target identity, may poison villager by mistake

when_not_to_use.zh: 想留毒药等待更确定的目标
when_not_to_use.en: Want to save poison for more certain target

when_not_to_use.zh: 场上还有猎人，投票可以出狼
when_not_to_use.en: Hunter still alive, can eliminate wolf through voting

description.zh: 第一晚根据发言或直觉盲毒可疑玩家，高风险高回报
description.en: Night one blind poison suspicious player based on speech or intuition, high risk high reward

description.zh: 第一晚直接救人，保护可能的神职
description.en: Night one blind save to protect possible special roles

description.zh: 第一晚不使用任何药，观察局势再决定
description.en: Night one use no potion, observe situation before deciding

description.zh: 救人后白天跳出报银水，建立信任圈
description.en: After saving, reveal during day to report silver water, establish trust circle

description.zh: 全程不跳女巫，暗中使用药物影响局势
description.en: Never reveal Witch, secretly use potions to influence game

common_mistakes.zh: 第一晚盲救边缘玩家，浪费解药
common_mistakes.en: Night one blind saving marginal player, wasting heal

common_mistakes.zh: 过早跳出女巫身份，成为狼人目标
common_mistakes.en: Revealing Witch identity too early, becoming werewolf target

common_mistakes.zh: 盲毒好人，帮助狼人阵营
common_mistakes.en: Blind poisoning villager, helping werewolf team

common_mistakes.zh: 两瓶药都不用就被淘汰，浪费技能
common_mistakes.en: Getting eliminated without using either potion, wasting abilities

common_mistakes.zh: 同一晚想同时使用解药和毒药（规则不允许）
common_mistakes.en: Trying to use both potions same night (rules don't allow)

tips.zh: 女巫是狼队的高优先级目标，要善于隐藏身份
tips.en: Witch is high priority target for wolves, must hide identity well

tips.zh: 解药和毒药的使用时机比使用本身更重要
tips.en: Timing of potion use is more important than the use itself

tips.zh: 如果预言家被刀，优先考虑救预言家
tips.en: If Seer is killed, prioritize saving the Seer

tips.zh: 毒药可以在夜间直接减少狼人数量，非常强力
tips.en: Poison can directly reduce werewolf count at night, very powerful

tips.zh: 女巫不能毒被狼人刀死的玩家（已经死亡）
tips.en: Witch cannot poison player killed by werewolves (already dead)

tips.zh: 如果猎人被毒死，猎人不能开枪（特殊规则）
tips.en: If Hunter is poisoned, Hunter cannot shoot (special rule)
